name: Virlo Social Media Brain
description:
The Virlo MCP allows for researching, managing, and improving workflows when it comes to leveraging data from shortform video platforms. Researching shortform video content, ideating, and executing automations around shortform video research.  The following are social media functions that can be performed: 

Spot trends — virlo trends digest, virlo videos digest 💲 $0.25 · virlo hashtags list 💲 $0.05
Research a niche — virlo orbit create 💲 one-shot keyword search across platforms
Keep watching a niche — virlo comet create 💲 recurring scheduled scrapes
Deep-dive a creator — virlo satellite creator tiktok @handle --include videos,outliers 💲
Explain a viral video — virlo satellite video-outlier <url> --platform tiktok 💲
Research sounds — virlo sounds trending / search / usage-history 💲
Track creators & videos over time — virlo tracking creators add, virlo tracking videos add 💲
Get notified — virlo webhooks create --url … --events comet.run.completed,…
Hand it to an agent — virlo skill install teaches Claude the whole surface

_published_faq.name: How do I add Virlo Social Media Brain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Virlo Social Media Brain to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://dev.virlo.ai/api/mcp/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Virlo Social Media Brain MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Virlo Social Media Brain lists 50 MCP tools, including analyze_video, batch_lookup_creators, check_job_status, collect_creator_posts, create_niche_monitor, delete_niche_monitor, get_breakout_sounds, get_creator_audience_demographics, get_creator_audience_geography, get_creator_sounds, get_credit_balance, and get_emerging_trends.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Virlo Social Media Brain?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Virlo Social Media Brain in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Virlo Social Media Brain MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Virlo Social Media Brain requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Virlo Social Media Brain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Virlo Social Media Brain is developed by Red Lab LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
